showtimeExperiences.name: UltraAVX
showtimeExperiences.description: More screen, more sound, more epic— it’s ultra for a reason. With superior picture quality, stunningly crisp detail, and Dolby surround sound, UltraAVX offers an upgraded theatre experience that allows you to immerse yourself in the action, sci-fi and fantasy in front of you from a comfy leather seat.

showtimeExperiences.name: VIP 18+
showtimeExperiences.description: Give dinner and a movie a whole new meaning with a premium experience. Get specialty food and signature cocktails delivered right to your seat in an adults-only auditorium.

showtimeExperiences.name: VIP 19+
showtimeExperiences.description: Give dinner and a movie a whole new meaning with a premium experience. Get specialty food and signature cocktails delivered right to your seat in an adults-only auditorium.

showtimeExperiences.name: IMAX
showtimeExperiences.description: From heart-pounding audio to crystal clear imagery on the largest screens, IMAX offers the world’s most immersive movie experience.

showtimeExperiences.name: 4DX
showtimeExperiences.description: 4DX offers a one-of-a-kind, multi-sensory cinematic experience that immerses you in the action on screen by synchronizing motion seats with environmental effects like water, wind, lightning, scent, and more.

showtimeExperiences.name: ScreenX
showtimeExperiences.description: ScreenX expands your movie experience with an expansive, 270-degree panoramic screen in select scenes that naturally fills your peripheral vision and surrounds you with boundless adventure.

showtimeExperiences.name: Clubhouse
showtimeExperiences.description: Enjoy playtime before showtime. Kids can explore our safe and fun indoor playground while you sit and watch from your seats.

showtimeExperiences.name: 3D
showtimeExperiences.description: Watch your movie come to life in RealD 3D! Enjoy a premium large format movie theatre designed with cutting-edge cinema technologies.

showtimeExperiences.name: D-BOX
showtimeExperiences.description: D-BOX seating brings movies to life through an extremely realistic & immersive combination of movements and vibrations that are perfectly synchronized to the action on-screen.

showtimeExperiences.name: Prime Seats
showtimeExperiences.description: Reserve a Prime Seat in select traditional auditoriums, and enjoy a larger seat in a reserved row.

showtimeExperiences.name: Recliner
showtimeExperiences.description: Sit back. Like, waaaay back. Enjoy the movie from a luxurious, fully reclining leather chair with plenty of legroom and space between each row.

showtimeExperiences.name: High Frame Rate
showtimeExperiences.description: High Frame Rate (HFR) movies are created with more than the standard 24 frames per second, delivering a smoother and more realistic visual experience.

showtimeExperiences.name: 70mm
showtimeExperiences.description: 70mm projection offers a much crisper, more uniform image with 3 times the resolution of standard digital formats. Projecting the film in its native format provides a wider image and exceptional level of detail, resulting in an immersive and unparalleled cinematic experience.

showtimeExperiences.name: Stars & Strollers Test
showtimeExperiences.description: Watch a new release movie with baby in tow! We’ve got you both covered in a baby-friendly movie environment with lowered volume, dimmed lighting, and change tables.

showtimeExperiences.name: Sensory Friendly
showtimeExperiences.description: Sensory Friendly Screenings provide a lights up, sound down environment for individuals with autism spectrum disorder and others to enjoy.

showtimeExperiences.name: Dolby Atmos
showtimeExperiences.description: Dolby® introduces a dramatic new listening experience to movie-goers by precisely positioning and moving sounds anywhere in the theatre. Dolby Atmos mimics the way sound behaves in real life, heightening the realism and impact of every scene.

showtimeExperiences.name: Regular
showtimeExperiences.description: A classic movie-going experience: big screen, big sound, and reserved seating.

showtimeExperiences.name: EVENT
showtimeExperiences.description: Enjoy your favourite movie in the state of the art theatre with modern comfortable seating, cupholders and plenty of legroom.

showtimeExperiences.name: Stars & Strollers
showtimeExperiences.description: Parents—bring naptime to showtime. Watch the latest new releases in a baby-friendly environment with soft lighting, reduced volume, and other amenities.

showtimeExperiences.name: IMAX 3D
showtimeExperiences.description: The size and curvature of the IMAX screen allows for a larger and more immersive image to be experienced in IMAX® 3D - the images jump off the screen and into your lap.

showtimeExperiences.name: Laser Projection
showtimeExperiences.description: Experience the brightest picture and a wide range of rich, dynamic colours with laser projection.

showtimeExperiences.name: HDR by Barco
showtimeExperiences.description: Enhance your UltraAVX experience with the magic of HDR by Barco. Step into a world of unrivaled cinematic beauty where colours come alive with stunning vibrancy, brightness reaches new heights, and clarity astounds at every turn.

showtimeExperiences.name: IMAX HFR
showtimeExperiences.description: From heart-pounding audio to crystal clear imagery on the largest screens, IMAX offers the world’s most immersive movie experience.

showtimeExperiences.name: IMAX 3D HFR
showtimeExperiences.description: From heart-pounding audio to crystal clear imagery on the largest screens, IMAX offers the world’s most immersive movie experience.

showtimeExperiences.name: IMAX 70MM
showtimeExperiences.description: Combining larger than life IMAX technology with the detail of IMAX 70MM film, this format is the highest quality imaging presentation ever devised. IMAX 70MM film offers nine times the resolution of standard 35mm film.
